    subtotal = sum(int(item["unit_cents"]) * int(item["qty"]) for item in items)
    discount = (subtotal * int(discount_bps)) // 10000
    net = subtotal - discount
    return {
        "subtotal_cents": subtotal,

        "net_cents": net,
        "x0_cents": 0,
        "x_u_cents": 100,
        "x_d_cents": -100,
        "stop_on_step1_up": True,
    }

        "tax_cents": tax,
        "gross_cents": gross,
